reviews.title: Never change phones
reviews.text: I spent an hour, and I am completely unable to move my conversations to the new phone. They have got this so that you can move your ID and your contacts, but you cannot move your conversations, so I’ve lost everything for the last year all because I bought a new phone! Total junk!

reviews.title: If I could give it 0 stars I would
reviews.text: The app constantly takes 30 minutes or more just to deliver a message, and many times just disconnects from the network for no reason.

reviews.title: Easily one of the worst paid app I ever used
reviews.text: I don’t know how an app can be so buggy and unpredictable in this age. And this is a paid app for God’s sake! It’s easily one of the worst paid apps I have ever used. Always something or the other.. it doesn’t connect.. those red and orange lines at the top. Have to restart so frequently. Honestly surprised how this is still on the AppStore. Very frustrating user experience.

reviews.title: Issues
reviews.text: So many issues for a paid app.

reviews.title: Messages not sending/going through
reviews.text: For several weeks now, when I send regular text message and then get out of the app. It will not go through to the person I sent it to unless I open the app back up and it reloads and then it will send the message and if I don’t do it right away the message will literally take hours to be sent if I don’t go back into the app. The last couple updates have been trash and I’ve been having all kinds of issues like this and the app not even opening when I receive a message.

reviews.title: Says initialise then nothing
reviews.text:
UPDATE: WON’T CALL OR RECEIVE CALLS.  🤦‍♀️ Do not pay money for this absolute waste of space. Zero support too. 
—-
Very often won’t call. Says it’s initialising but doesn’t. I like it other than this.

reviews.title: DEMAND REFUND READ BELOW THREEMA WILL NOT BE SECURE ANYMORE
reviews.text: Switzerland is pushing a new surveillance ordinance that would force VPN, email, and messaging providers to verify user identities, log metadata for six months, and decrypt any data they control on demand. Privacy-focused firms warn this could end anonymous use of Swiss services and make Switzerland's surveillance powers even tougher than those in the US. This includes proton mail and Threema etc. AVOID all Swiss services from this point forward.

reviews.title: Ok
reviews.text: Good app but keeps crashing even during a call and a screen would pop up asking me to send a report. The quality of audio calls could be a hit and miss. The desktop app is still quite basic. Still long way to go.

reviews.title: lost everything
reviews.text: have used this for 6 years. suddenly started not connecting every afternoon for several hours. ultimately had to delete app and redownload. app failed to import my backup safe or even my ID. had to start over completely from scratch with a new ID and lost all my previous chats. customer service’s response along the way: “contact Apple App store.”

reviews.title: Location sharing
reviews.text: We paid seven dollars each to share location with each other, but once we're logged in and ready to go, there's no visible location sharing option.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: It doesn’t capture the contacts after 4 tries. Not good!

reviews.title: Never signed up
reviews.text: I never agreed to a subscription and there doesn’t seem to be any way to cancel this!

reviews.title: Unfamiliar charge
reviews.text: I am frustrated because you all are trying to charge me for your services and I never signed up for you on my apple account. I never downloaded your app. I don’t need your app. This is bad business.

reviews.title: NOT a SECURE MSG APP
reviews.text:
This is a paid only app and it boasts its superior encryption and privacy capabilities. Yet, despite so many users complaining about the inability to set a BURN ON READ TIMER or CUSTOM MESSAGE AUTO DELETE the app still only auto deletes messages after 1 week. 

Users need a custom burn on read timer ASAP. Only then will this app compete with WICKR.

reviews.title: Call Quality Subpar
reviews.text: Call quality and speed of connection is still subpar.
